known_limitations: Cross-section tube topology, NOT a sculpted production base mesh — no clean facial edge flow, no hands/feet detail, tube seams where limbs meet the torso overlap (expected self-intersection at joints).
No UV / no texture (validator reports UV absence as a WARN, not a failure).
shoulder_wide at value 1.0 produces a slightly spiky deltoid (low ring count).
Face is out of scope: head shape + approximate face width only; NO facial identity claim. Eye landmarks are a separate proxy experiment (docs/stylization-prototype-v1.1.md).
Auto (envelope) skin weights, not hand-painted; adequate for prototype deformation, not production.
NOT PRODUCTION APPROVED. Suitable for pipeline validation and body-proportion prototyping only.
